data.title: Secret gates pass forms that hide the commit or push from the text filter
data.description: Text gates cannot see every spelling: interpreters, scripts, git-run commands, spelled-apart verbs. Secrets can commit unscanned. Native git hooks are the planned fix.
data.repro: 1. Stage a synthetic key. 2. Run a listed form such as a script calling git. 3. Gate exits 0. Full list in the evidence.
data.expected: Spec Security: secret scan on commit and push
data.actual: Listed forms pass with no scan.
data.evidence: .workflow/evidence/sqlite-bug-tracker/attempt-5/e6.md DEF-E6-03; security round 5 in the feature Log row 30

data.title: Secret gates do not scan commit messages
data.description: A key typed in a commit message passes the commit and push gates and reaches the remote, because the scan reads the staged diff and commit contents only.
data.repro: 1. Commit with a synthetic key in the message. 2. Push. Both gates exit 0.
data.expected: core.md Security: never commit a secret

data.repro: 1. add with a national-format number in title. 2. show prints it as typed. 13 of 13 fixture rows.
